statement: The lab comparative campaign accepts an explicit registered eligible load-generator name, reserves that physical host before choosing data hosts, and refuses an invalid explicit choice without substitution through both dry-run and actual campaign selection.

constraints.statement: Reuse canonical live eligibility, boot de-duplication, measured client storage/Node requirements and data disk policy. Preserve bounded ordered locks, thermal policy and automatic selection when no explicit request exists. No fabricated inventory facts, aliases, artificial lock steering or invalid-request fallback.
New flag is lab-only; GCP --client-node remains executable path. No campaign performance/formation/release acceptance from selector proof.
